record_provenance_rule.statement: the committed v1 record's provenance block names its original builder (docs/design_synthesis/spacecraft_reference_drag/build_spacecraft_reference_drag.py) and the module it was built from (abep_sim/spacecraft_reference_drag.py, module_sha256 28bcc6bd...). The Rust builder reproduces the v1 record byte for byte, provenance block included: module_sha256 is the registered pin of the module the Rust register was transcribed from. While the module file exists, the Rust builder verifies it against the pin and refuses (MODEL_ERROR) on a difference (DIV-C-01); when it is absent (Python retired) it emits the pin (DIV-C-02). The Rust builder identity is recorded in this contract, the parity report and the migration ledger, not inside the immutable v1 record; a record built differently is a v2 record under a new contract
